components.name: Composer
components.description: The single entry point: text or one screenshot, attach left, send right.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; max-width: 44rem; padding: 0.875rem 0.75rem 0.625rem 1rem; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow); font: 400 1rem/1.65 Literata, 'Noto Serif Devanagari', serif; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--border)); } .ds-composer textarea { padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; resize: none; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; caret-color: var(--accent); } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder); opacity: 1; } .ds-actions { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-attach { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: none; color: var(--muted); } .ds-attach svg { width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; } .ds-attach:hover { background: var(--bubble); color: var(--text); } .ds-attach:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-send { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; } .ds-send svg { width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; } .ds-send:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; } .ds-send:enabled:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 75%, var(--text)); } .ds-send:enabled:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-progress { color: var(--muted); font: 400 0.875rem Literata, 'Noto Serif Devanagari', serif; } .ds-progress summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-progress summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-progress summary span { animation: ds-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { color: var(--text); } } .ds-progress ol { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.25rem; } .ds-chev { flex: none; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease-out); } details[open] > summary .ds-chev { transform: rotate(180deg); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-progress * { animation: none; transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-claim { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--text); font: 400 1rem/1.65 Literata, 'Noto Serif Devanagari', serif; } .ds-claim summary { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.875rem; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-claim summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-claim-text { flex: 1; } .ds-claim .ds-badge { flex: none; margin-top: 0.125rem; } .ds-claim .ds-chev { margin-top: 0.3rem; color: var(--muted); } .ds-evidence { padding: 0.75rem 0.875rem 0.875rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-evidence p { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-evidence ul { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; padding-left: 1.125rem; } .ds-evidence a { color: var(--link); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-domain { margin-left: 0.375rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-evidence .ds-meta { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-chev { flex: none; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease-out); } details[open] > summary .ds-chev { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--verdict) 14%, var(--bg)); color: var(--verdict); font: 500 0.875rem/1.6 Literata, 'Noto Serif Devanagari', serif; } .ds-badge svg { width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; stroke-width: 2.25; } .ds-badge-true { --verdict: var(--true); } .ds-badge-false { --verdict: var(--false); } .ds-badge-misleading { --verdict: var(--misleading); } .ds-badge-unverifiable { --verdict: var(--unverifiable); }

narrative.overview:
A fact-checker that looks and behaves like the chat assistant people already use: claude.ai, pinned by the user and executed straight. One question, one input, then a conversation. The world is warm paper rather than white screen: an ivory ground, warm near-black ink, one terracotta accent and one serif voice. A dark twin on warm charcoal follows the device setting; there is no theme toggle.

Plain HTML, CSS and JS with no build step. Every token is a custom property on `:root` in `style.css`, and a single `prefers-color-scheme: dark` block reassigns the same names. Components read those properties (the send arrow's white is the one literal), so both themes come from one rule set.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory ground (charcoal in dark), a white composer card, sand user bubbles, unboxed replies.
One accent, terracotta, for the mark, the send button, focus and selection.
Literata in every role, Noto Serif Devanagari for Hindi; one small size.
Verdicts as tinted badges pairing a colour, a drawn icon and a word.
Lucide-drawn line icons only; soft corners (0.5 / 0.75 / 1.25rem) and full pills.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only non-verdict hue. No second accent; hovers deepen the accent by mixing it toward the text colour (75%) rather than introducing a new one.

rules.name: The Verdict Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, red, orange and the verdict gray appear only in verdict badges (and red in error text), each paired with its icon and word so colour never carries the meaning alone.

rules.name: The Twin Rule
rules.body: A new colour is a new custom property with a value in both the light `:root` and the dark override. Never hard-code a colour in a component; the only literal is the send arrow's white, which sits on terracotta in both themes.

rules.name: The One Small Size Rule
rules.body: There are two text sizes in conversation: 1rem and `--small` (0.875rem). Nothing else.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Literata everywhere, with Noto Serif Devanagari only as its Hindi partner. No sans, no mono, no second display face.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the composer casts a shadow. Everything else is tone and hairline.

dos: Do set colour, size, radius and easing through the `:root` custom properties, with a dark value for every colour.
Do pair every verdict colour with its icon and word.
Do use Terracotta Ink, not Terracotta, for any text-sized accent.
Do draw new icons from Lucide, inline, stroked in `currentColor`.
Do keep every animation inside the reduced-motion reset.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour or a second typeface.
Don't use the verdict colours outside verdicts and error text.
Don't add a text size beyond the display, 1rem and 0.875rem.
Don't give anything but the composer a shadow.
Don't add labels, instruction blocks, avatars, or copy that repeats the heading or placeholder.
